items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: He's married wife, Emma. She's still playing. Emma Berry.

ctx.x: Little Willie. He lived out on Sedan Street. Little bit of a fella short fella. Man, he could pick up a key like that. And I mean play. Yeah. Well, I don't know how he passed out. But you had women folks like I was telling you. Oh, that Davis, Helen Edwards, Sadie, Ricard's old lady, what died there. He's married wife, Emma. She's still playing. Emma Berry.
